fields.raw: Take one pound of Potatoes, Boyle them till they peel, pound them in a morrer, melt half a pound of butter, a quarter of a pint of sack, put into them, take six eggs, leave out half yr whites, sweeten it to yr past, stir it all together, grate a little nutmeg in it when you bake it butter yr Dish very well, three quarters of an hour will bake it
